mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rider_location_summary ( order_id, rider_id, current_lng, current_lat, location_time, eta_minutes, update_time ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{riderId}, #{currentLng}, #{currentLat}, #{locationTime}, #{etaMinutes}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rider_id = #{riderId}, current_lng = #{currentLng}, current_lat = #{currentLat}, location_time = #{locationTime}, eta_minutes = #{etaMinutes}, update_time = NOW()
